name: Jean-François Puget (CPMP)
method: Built-in browser (Claude app browser pane), 2026-10-30: read the live public Kaggle profile page and the first page of the Competitions tab (sorted by Best Result) as rendered; competition medals read from the medal icons shown on each row (icon on screen for the top four rows, icon image name in the page for all twenty); medal tile counts read the same way; avatar image URL read from the profile header and downloaded with curl. An earlier draft of this file was treated as unverified and rebuilt from scratch.

teamNotes: The Kaggle completed list shows teammate account pictures (handles on hover) but no team name for any entry, so teamName is null on every row; nothing is credited from memory. The ARC Prize 2025 entry shows cpmpml and sorokin. The existing record's Hall of Fame label calls the 2025 team NVARC, but that name is not displayed on the Kaggle pages read here. Current 2026 memberships (nvbanana in ARC-2, NVARC3 in ARC-3) are already in the record and are not duplicated. Team medals are team results, not individual honours. The Nemotron challenge he is shown hosting is an NVIDIA competition, not a team entry. One PLAsTiCC teammate shows as a deleted account and is not named.
